description: CREATE STREAM ON VIEW as a DDL surface: the stream is created and listed by SHOW STREAMS under its UPPERCASED name, with APPEND_ONLY, with SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS, over a view carrying a WHERE predicate, and alongside a stream on the underlying TABLE in the same schema (both list). IF NOT EXISTS is idempotent - a second CREATE for the same name neither fails nor produces a duplicate. Naming a view that does not exist is refused with Snowflake's own live-verified sentence, View 'NON_EXISTENT_VIEW' does not exist or not authorized. Converted 1:1 from stream/StreamOnViewTest (now retired), which was a JDBC test that scanned the SHOW STREAMS ResultSet row by row for a name; each such scan is expressed here as a COUNT over RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()) filtered on the quoted lowercase name column, which asserts the same thing including the uppercase normalisation.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name STRING, age INTEGER)
INSERT INTO users VALUES (1, 'Alice', 30)
INSERT INTO users VALUES (2, 'Bob', 25)
CREATE VIEW active_users AS SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE age >= 25
CREATE STREAM user_stream ON VIEW active_users
SHOW STREAMS
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" = 'USER_STREAM'
CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER, name STRING, price DECIMAL)
CREATE VIEW expensive_products AS SELECT * FROM products WHERE price > 100
CREATE STREAM product_stream ON VIEW expensive_products APPEND_ONLY = TRUE
SHOW STREAMS
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" = 'PRODUCT_STREAM'
CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER, customer_id INTEGER, amount DECIMAL)
INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1, 100, 50.00)
INSERT INTO orders VALUES (2, 101, 75.00)
CREATE VIEW large_orders AS SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount > 60
CREATE STREAM order_stream ON VIEW large_orders SHOW_INITIAL_ROWS = TRUE
SHOW STREAMS
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" = 'ORDER_STREAM'
CREATE STREAM test_stream ON VIEW non_existent_view

error.messageContains: does not exist or not authorized

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER, name STRING, salary DECIMAL)
INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1, 'John', 50000)
INSERT INTO employees VALUES (2, 'Jane', 60000)
CREATE VIEW high_earners AS SELECT * FROM employees WHERE salary > 55000
CREATE STREAM table_stream ON TABLE employees
CREATE STREAM view_stream ON VIEW high_earners
SHOW STREAMS
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" IN ('TABLE_STREAM', 'VIEW_STREAM')
CREATE TABLE inventory (id INTEGER, product_name STRING, quantity INTEGER)
INSERT INTO inventory VALUES (1, 'Widget', 100)
INSERT INTO inventory VALUES (2, 'Gadget', 5)
CREATE VIEW low_stock AS SELECT * FROM inventory WHERE quantity < 10
CREATE STREAM stock_stream ON VIEW low_stock
SHOW STREAMS
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" = 'STOCK_STREAM'
CREATE TABLE customers (id INTEGER, name STRING)
CREATE VIEW customer_view AS SELECT * FROM customers
CREATE STREAM customer_stream ON VIEW customer_view
CREATE STREAM IF NOT EXISTS customer_stream ON VIEW customer_view
SHOW STREAMS
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" = 'CUSTOMER_STREAM'
